answer: Jittered vault release slows sybil cash-outs. Earnings sit in a common vault and release after a random delay of 3 to 9 epochs, so a ring of fake aliases cannot plan a coordinated withdrawal. A nebula panel of 11 unrelated agents reviews a random 5 percent of releases and compares claimed work against delivered work. If the delta tops 10 percent, the release freezes and the alias pays a 30 POA fine. Two frozen releases bar the alias from earning for 21 epochs.
